content:
Use my uploaded character sheet as the ONLY reference for the character. Preserve the exact facial features, hairstyle, body proportions, skin tone, and identity throughout the entire video. The character must remain perfectly consistent. Do NOT change the face, body, or hairstyle. Only the outfit and environment change.

Create a premium 15-second cinematic travel-fashion commercial where the character journeys through seven iconic countries. Every transition is triggered by the character touching or adjusting her outfit. As the outfit transforms, the entire environment seamlessly changes into the next country.

The camera follows the character in one continuous cinematic shot with smooth movement and no cuts.

Sequence:

① France 🇫🇷
The character wears an elegant Parisian luxury outfit. She gently adjusts her blazer collar. As she pulls the collar into place, her outfit transforms into the next country's traditional fashion while the Eiffel Tower and the streets of Paris seamlessly become the next location.

② Japan 🇯🇵
She now wears a modern luxury kimono-inspired outfit. She gently holds one sleeve and spins gracefully. During the spin, both her outfit and the scenery transform into South Korea.

Background: Gyeongbokgung Palace with Seoul skyline.

③ South Korea 🇰🇷
She wears a modern designer hanbok-inspired outfit. She lightly smooths the front of her jacket. As her hand moves downward, the outfit transforms while the palace becomes the streets of Italy.

Background: Colosseum and Rome cityscape.

④ Italy 🇮🇹
She wears elegant Italian luxury fashion. She adjusts her sunglasses and smiles confidently. As she lowers her hand, both the outfit and scenery transform.

Background: Colosseum and classic Roman architecture.

⑤ United Arab Emirates 🇦🇪
She now wears a luxurious modern abaya-inspired couture outfit. She gently lifts the flowing fabric. As it falls, the environment transforms.

Background: Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai at sunset.

⑥ India 🇮🇳
She wears an elegant contemporary designer saree. She gracefully adjusts the pallu over her shoulder. During the motion, the outfit transforms once more.

Background: Taj Mahal during golden hour.

⑦ United States 🇺🇸 (Final Hero Scene)

She now wears premium New York luxury street fashion. She confidently walks toward the camera as Times Square and the New York skyline surround her. The camera slowly pushes in while she gives a confident smile, ending with a premium fashion-commercial hero shot.

Every transition is physically motivated by touching, adjusting, pulling, or spinning the clothing. The outfit and environment transform simultaneously with seamless cinematic match cuts, realistic fabric simulation, and premium architectural morphing.

Camera:
One continuous tracking shot, smooth dolly movement, occasional orbit, 50mm and 85mm cinematic lenses, shallow depth of field.

Lighting:
Natural golden-hour lighting adapted to each country with realistic reflections, soft rim lighting, and cinematic atmosphere.

Style:
Luxury Louis Vuitton, Dior, Gucci, Chanel global fashion campaign mixed with National Geographic travel cinematography.

Ultra-realistic, premium editorial quality, flawless fabric physics, authentic architecture, 8K HDR, award-winning commercial cinematography, smooth transitions, no glitches, no text, no watermark.

Usa mi hoja de personaje cargada como la ÚNICA referencia para el personaje. Conserva las características faciales exactas, el peinado, las proporciones del cuerpo, el tono de piel y la identidad a lo largo de todo el video. El personaje debe permanecer perfectamente consistente. NO cambies la cara, el cuerpo o el peinado. Solo el atuendo y el entorno cambian.

Crea un comercial de moda de viaje cinematográfico premium de 15 segundos donde el personaje viaja a través de siete países icónicos. Cada transición se activa cuando el personaje toca o ajusta su atuendo. A medida que el atuendo se transforma, todo el entorno cambia sin problemas al siguiente país.

La cámara sigue al personaje en una toma cinematográfica continua con movimiento suave y sin cortes.

Secuencia:

① Francia 🇫🇷
El personaje lleva un elegante atuendo de lujo parisino. Ajusta suavemente el cuello de su blazer. Al colocar el cuello en su lugar, su atuendo se transforma en la moda tradicional del siguiente país mientras la Torre Eiffel y las calles de París se convierten sin problemas en la siguiente ubicación.

Ahora lleva un atuendo moderno inspirado en un kimono de lujo. Sostiene suavemente una manga y gira con gracia. Durante el giro, tanto su atuendo como el paisaje se transforman en Corea del Sur.

Fondo: Palacio de Gyeongbokgung con el horizonte de Seúl.

③ Corea del Sur 🇰🇷
Lleva un atuendo moderno inspirado en un hanbok de diseñador. Alisa ligeramente la parte delantera de su chaqueta. A medida que su mano se mueve hacia abajo, el atuendo se transforma mientras el palacio se convierte en las calles de Italia.

Fondo: Coliseo y paisaje urbano de Roma.

④ Italia 🇮🇹
Lleva una elegante moda de lujo italiana. Ajusta sus gafas de sol y sonríe con confianza. Al bajar la mano, tanto el atuendo como el paisaje se transforman.

Fondo: Coliseo y arquitectura romana clásica.

⑤ Emiratos Árabes Unidos 🇦🇪
Ahora lleva un lujoso atuendo de alta costura inspirado en una abaya moderna. Levanta suavemente la tela fluida. Al caer, el entorno se transforma.

Fondo: Burj Khalifa y el centro de Dubái al atardecer.

⑥ India 🇮🇳
Lleva un elegante sari de diseñador contemporáneo. Ajusta con gracia el pallu sobre su hombro. Durante el movimiento, el atuendo se transforma una vez más.

Fondo: Taj Mahal durante la hora dorada.

⑦ Estados Unidos 🇺🇸 (Escena Final de Héroe)

Ahora lleva moda de lujo callejera de Nueva York. Camina con confianza hacia la cámara mientras Times Square y el horizonte de Nueva York la rodean. La cámara se acerca lentamente mientras ella da una sonrisa confiada, terminando con una toma de héroe de comercial de moda premium.

Cada transición está motivada físicamente por tocar, ajustar, tirar o girar la ropa. El atuendo y el entorno se transforman simultáneamente con cortes de coincidencia cinematográficos sin problemas, simulación realista de telas y transformación arquitectónica premium.

Una toma continua de seguimiento, movimiento suave de dolly, órbita ocasional, lentes cinematográficos de 50mm y 85mm, poca profundidad de campo.

Iluminación:
Iluminación natural de la hora dorada adaptada a cada país con reflejos realistas, iluminación de borde suave y atmósfera cinematográfica.

Estilo:
Campaña de moda global de Louis Vuitton, Dior, Gucci, Chanel mezclada con cinematografía de viaje de National Geographic.

Calidad editorial ultra-realista, premium, física de telas impecable, arquitectura auténtica, 8K HDR, cinematografía comercial galardonada, transiciones suaves, sin fallos, sin texto, sin marca de agua.

--- TWEET CITADO ---
La vista cambia con cada cuadro.

Create a 15-second luxury eyewear commercial inside a modern designer boutique with floor-to-ceiling glass, polished marble floors, elegant architectural lighting, and a premium fashion editorial atmosphere.

업로드한 캐릭터 시트를 캐릭터의 유일한 참조로 사용하세요. 얼굴 특징, 헤어스타일, 신체 비율, 피부 톤, 정체성을 비디오 전체에서 정확히 유지하세요. 캐릭터는 완벽하게 일관성을 유지해야 합니다. 얼굴, 몸, 헤어스타일을 변경하지 마세요. 오직 의상과 환경만 변경됩니다.

캐릭터가 일곱 개의 상징적인 국가를 여행하는 프리미엄 15초 시네마틱 여행-패션 광고를 만드세요. 모든 전환은 캐릭터가 의상을 만지거나 조정할 때 발생합니다. 의상이 변형되면서 전체 환경이 다음 국가로 매끄럽게 전환됩니다.

카메라는 캐릭터를 한 번의 연속적인 시네마틱 샷으로 따라가며 부드러운 움직임과 컷 없이 진행됩니다.

배경: 콜로세움과 고전적인 로마 건축물.

그녀는 이제 럭셔리한 현대 아바야에서 영감을 받은 꾸뛰르 의상을 입고 있습니다. 그녀는 부드럽게 흐르는 천을 들어 올립니다. 천이 떨어지면서, 환경이 변형됩니다.

배경: 부르즈 칼리파와 일몰의 두바이 다운타운.

⑥ 인도 🇮🇳
